performance.measurement_notes: PP13 DSAPI throughput profile. GLM-5.2-FP8 has 78 main transformer layers and needs enough queued requests to fill the 13-stage layer pipeline. The safe direct vLLM baseline targets 32 sequences, 16384 batched tokens, 4 GiB fixed BF16 KV per rank, and eager execution after a 128-sequence/65536-token launch envelope hit NVIDIA driver NV_ERR_NO_MEMORY during CUDA initialization on 8-layer stages. Raise the batch envelope only after direct smoke and batch sweep establish launch headroom. The guarded vLLM 0.23.0 wheel overlay uses FLASHMLA_SPARSE attention with BF16 KV, Marlin FP8 MoE, an SM12 FlashMLA sparse validation shim, a DS4 Triton indexed BF16 sparse-MLA fallback for Spark GB10, and a DS4 dense-last-window sparse indexer fallback because the upstream DeepGEMM fp8_fp4_mqa_logits indexer kernel rejects the architecture. The Spark BF16-fallback launch overrides GLM's native 2048 sparse index_topk to 128 for the first usable-speed pass; raise this only after direct smoke and batch sweep establish headroom. FlashInfer sparse decode did not provide a clean GB10 path: XQA rejected GLM's 64 query heads, TRTLLM-GEN rejected the Spark architecture, and CUTE-DSL rejected sparse_mla_top_k. FP8 E4M3 KV produced corrupt repeated-token smoke outputs on GB10; LMCache HMA with BF16 KV loaded but hung direct OpenAI smoke requests before normal vLLM scheduler accounting.
performance.target: 13-stage GLM-5.2-FP8 frontier throughput pipeline with BF16 KV and no external KV connector.
